input._script:
using Base64
using JSON3
const B = ""
work = get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp")
root = joinpath(work, "stade_chain", "gd_" * string(round(Int, time()))); mkpath(root)
write(joinpath(root, "p.tgz"), base64decode(B)); run(`tar -xzf $(joinpath(root, "p.tgz")) -C $root`)
t0 = time()
p16 = run(pipeline(`julia --startup-file=no $(joinpath(root,"gendiff2.jl")) $(joinpath(root,"t16"))`; stdout = joinpath(root, "o16.txt"), stderr = joinpath(root, "e16.txt")); wait = false)
p17 = run(pipeline(`julia --startup-file=no $(joinpath(root,"gendiff2.jl")) $(joinpath(root,"t17"))`; stdout = joinpath(root, "o17.txt"), stderr = joinpath(root, "e17.txt")); wait = false)
wait(p16); wait(p17)
l16 = readlines(joinpath(root, "o16.txt")); l17 = readlines(joinpath(root, "o17.txt"))
d16 = Dict(join(split(l)[1:end-1], " ") => split(l)[end] for l in l16 if !isempty(strip(l)))
d17 = Dict(join(split(l)[1:end-1], " ") => split(l)[end] for l in l17 if !isempty(strip(l)))
changed = [k for k in sort(collect(keys(d17))) if get(d16, k, "") != d17[k]]
err17 = [k for k in sort(collect(keys(d17))) if startswith(d17[k], "ERR")]
err16 = [k for k in sort(collect(keys(d16))) if startswith(d16[k], "ERR")]
println(JSON3.write(Dict("host" => gethostname(), "julia" => string(VERSION), "seconds" => time() - t0, "n16" => length(d16), "n17" => length(d17),
    "n_changed" => length(changed), "changed" => changed, "err16" => err16, "err17" => err17, "e17" => (isfile(joinpath(root,"e17.txt")) ? first(read(joinpath(root,"e17.txt"), String), 600) : ""))))
